test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following options is the closest approximate value which will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation?

3.01³ ÷ 2.99 × 6.01 = ?
solution:
**Given:**

3.013 ÷ 2.99 × 6.01 = ?

Concept used:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47485e25d1b30c57dc271863db8b99be0c8e209069b2596cc885911d898a8a78.png] 

**Calculation:**

3.013 ÷ 2.99 × 6.01 = ?

⇒ 3³ ÷ 3 × 6

⇒ 3² × 6

⇒ 9 × 6

⇒ 54

**The closest approximate value is 54.**
